nl: Apply only the commit 'Fix rounding error 4' from the branch develop to main (the current branch) as a new commit.

setup.description: A Git repository with a branch develop two commits ahead of main; main is checked out.
setup.bash:
git init -q -b main
git config user.name 'Bench User'
git config user.email bench@example.com
git config core.autocrlf false
printf '%s' '# calc-3
' > 'README.md'
mkdir -p 'src' && printf '%s' 'print('\''v1'\'')
' > 'src/app.py'
git add -A && GIT_AUTHOR_DATE='2026-10-01 08:00:00 +0000' GIT_COMMITTER_DATE='2026-10-01 08:00:00 +0000' git commit -qm 'Initial commit'
mkdir -p 'src' && printf '%s' 'def helper():
    return 1
' > 'src/util.py'
git add -A && GIT_AUTHOR_DATE='2026-10-01 08:01:00 +0000' GIT_COMMITTER_DATE='2026-10-01 08:01:00 +0000' git commit -qm 'Add helper module'
git switch -qc develop
mkdir -p 'src' && printf '%s' 'ROUND = 2
' > 'src/math.py'
git add -A && GIT_AUTHOR_DATE='2026-10-01 08:02:00 +0000' GIT_COMMITTER_DATE='2026-10-01 08:02:00 +0000' git commit -qm 'Fix rounding error 4'
mkdir -p 'src' && printf '%s' 'FLAG = True
' > 'src/experimental.py'
git add -A && GIT_AUTHOR_DATE='2026-10-01 08:03:00 +0000' GIT_COMMITTER_DATE='2026-10-01 08:03:00 +0000' git commit -qm 'Add experimental flag'
git switch -q main
setup.pwsh:
git init -q -b main
git config user.name 'Bench User'
git config user.email bench@example.com
git config core.autocrlf false
[IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path $PWD 'README.md'), '# calc-3
')
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force 'src' | Out-Null; [IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path $PWD 'src/app.py'), 'print(''v1'')
')
git add -A; $env:GIT_AUTHOR_DATE = '2026-10-01 08:00:00 +0000'; $env:GIT_COMMITTER_DATE = '2026-10-01 08:00:00 +0000'; git commit -qm 'Initial commit'
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force 'src' | Out-Null; [IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path $PWD 'src/util.py'), 'def helper():
    return 1
')
git add -A; $env:GIT_AUTHOR_DATE = '2026-10-01 08:01:00 +0000'; $env:GIT_COMMITTER_DATE = '2026-10-01 08:01:00 +0000'; git commit -qm 'Add helper module'
git switch -qc develop
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force 'src' | Out-Null; [IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path $PWD 'src/math.py'), 'ROUND = 2
')
git add -A; $env:GIT_AUTHOR_DATE = '2026-10-01 08:02:00 +0000'; $env:GIT_COMMITTER_DATE = '2026-10-01 08:02:00 +0000'; git commit -qm 'Fix rounding error 4'
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force 'src' | Out-Null; [IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path $PWD 'src/experimental.py'), 'FLAG = True
')
git add -A; $env:GIT_AUTHOR_DATE = '2026-10-01 08:03:00 +0000'; $env:GIT_COMMITTER_DATE = '2026-10-01 08:03:00 +0000'; git commit -qm 'Add experimental flag'
git switch -q main

subjects.stdout:
Fix rounding error 4
Add helper module
Initial commit

oracle_program: git.log "." revision: "develop" message: "Fix rounding error 4" count: 1 |> git.cherry_pick
reference_bash: git cherry-pick $(git log develop --format=%H --grep='Fix rounding error 4' -F -n 1)
reference_pwsh: $h = git log develop --format=%H --grep='Fix rounding error 4' -F -n 1; git cherry-pick $h

negatives.defect: brings the experimental commit as well
